decision: Automatic bounded dispatch: stock small FP32, tiled large/masked/FP16 inference; explicit backends/training remain original

methodology.timing: warm wall-clock with CUDA synchronization, excludes input generation/transfers and initial compilation
methodology.order: alternating stock/adapted in each of two independent processes
methodology.baseline: Pinned ComfyUI attention_sub_quad plus its original math and CUDA free-memory function, extracted without starting ComfyUI
methodology.memory: additional peak torch.cuda.memory_allocated bytes, not total Windows VRAM/driver memory
methodology.benchmark_dtype: FP32, unmasked; FP16/masks/layouts covered separately by numerical tests
limitations: Single RX580; desktop/background services not stopped
Synthetic tensors only: no models, workflows or image/text generation
Small calls retain the original math but add dispatch overhead; gains are not universal
First interrupted probe stalled during additive-mask operator compilation; comparison-to-negative-infinity replaced isneginf without changing mask semantics
Native sliced FP16 GEMM was unsupported; final FP16 inputs use FP32 compute with original output dtype
No end-to-end model speed, training validation or other GPU-family claim

installation.scope: ComfyUI source installation block only; full dependency/bootstrap installer not repeated
